memory.summary:
The group consisting of Diego, Leo, Mei, Noor, and Peter has established a tradition of enjoying vegan street tacos from Tacos El Jefe after their AI project meetings, which are scheduled at Caroline's Café. They met on December 21st for discussions followed by vegan street tacos around 1 PM. Diego, Andy, and Mei agreed to meet again for further discussions on the same day at 3 PM, with Samantha also invited.

On December 22nd, during separate conversations with Peter at the market and Samantha at the gym, Diego proposed that they continue this tradition of meeting every Wednesday at 3 PM at Caroline's Café. Peter expressed his enthusiasm for the continuation of the taco tradition after each meeting.

Samantha suggested a meeting next Tuesday to discuss the AI project's musical elements and invited Diego to join them. After their respective workouts, Diego proposed a get-together for vegan tacos with Samantha at 8 AM on the same day. However, in a conversation with Samantha at the market on December 22nd, Diego proposed changing the meeting time to 5 PM instead of 4 PM so they could catch up after their meal.

In another conversation with Samantha at the market around 10 AM on December 22nd, Diego suggested discussing AI ideas for their zine club next week at 5 PM, and Samantha agreed to make it a regular meeting like the tacos tradition, inviting Diego to join her there next Wednesday. Their next AI project meeting is planned for December 7th.

On December 22nd, Diego also spoke with Andy at the market, and they decided to meet on the following Tuesday at 3 PM at Caroline's Café, along with Noor and Mei, to discuss AI musical ideas for their project.
